# Redition Pharma Ltd.

> WHO-GMP Schedule M certified pharmaceutical formulations manufacturer specializing in neurovascular formulations, neuropathic analgesics, metabolic remodeling complexes, and adult vitality tablets for institutional hospital supply and pan-India PCD distribution.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Redition Pharma Ltd.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Institutional Hospital Supply**: Rate contracts, hospital formulary tie-ups, multi-tier tenders, and dedicated institutional batch reserve.
- **PCD Pharma Franchise**: Monopoly district rights, promotional inputs, marketing dossiers, and protected pricing across India.
- **Quality & Analytics**: In-house HPLC monograph testing, automated visual inspection, real-time differential pressure cleanroom monitoring, and batch Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued for 100% of shipments.
- **Logistics**: Validated cold-chain and temperature-controlled dispatch across pan-India transport corridors.

## Core Pharmaceutical Formulations

### 1. ADNOSINE-108 Tablets
- **Category**: Neurovascular & Mitochondrial Bioenergetics
- **Composition**: Adenosine 5-Monophosphate (AMP) 2.5mg, L-Arginine Decarboxylated 2.5mg & L-Carnosine 25.0mg
- **Dosage Form**: Film-Coated Tablet (10 x 1 x 10 Tablets in Moisture-Barrier Blister Pack)
- **MRP**: ₹1450.00
- **URL**: https://reditionpharma.com/product/adnosine-108-tablets
- **Key Advantage**: Tri-pathway neuro-mitochondrial formulation that replenishes cellular ATP reserves, enhances endothelial microvascular perfusion via decarboxylated L-arginine, and halts advanced glycation end-products (AGEs) along nerve fibers via L-carnosine.

### 2. MACSINE-109 Tablets
- **Category**: Diabetic Neuropathy & Axonal Myelin Remodeling
- **Composition**: Alpha Lipoic Acid 100mg, Benfotiamine 100mg, Calcium Carbonate 500mg, Chromium Picolinate 200mcg, Folic Acid 1.5mg, Inositol 100mg, Methylcobalamin 1500mcg, Pyridoxine HCl 3mg & Vitamin D3 1000 IU
- **Dosage Form**: Film-Coated Tablet (10 x 1 x 10 Blister Pack)
- **MRP**: ₹1380.00
- **URL**: https://reditionpharma.com/product/macsine-109-tablets
- **Key Advantage**: Comprehensive 9-in-1 neurotrophic complex stimulating myelin basic protein synthesis, controlling neuropathic paresthesia, and protecting endoneurial microvessels.

### 3. PREDY-NT 37.5/10 Tablets
- **Category**: Neuropathic Analgesia & CNS Neuromodulation (Schedule H)
- **Composition**: Pregabalin (Sustained Release) 37.5mg with Nortriptyline Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets
- **Dosage Form**: Sustained-Release Film-Coated Tablet (10 x 10 Tablets)
- **MRP**: ₹150.00
- **URL**: https://reditionpharma.com/product/predy-nt-tablets
- **Key Advantage**: Dual-action neuropathic analgesia combining sustained-release Pregabalin with Nortriptyline HCl for 24-hour relief of peripheral neuropathy, sciatica, and post-herpetic neuralgia with minimal sedation.

### 4. QLONG-GOLD Tablets
- **Category**: Endothelial Nitric Oxide & Adult Vitality
- **Composition**: L-Arginine, L-Citrulline, Fenugreek Extract, Biopeprine, Tribulus Terrestris, Hypericum Perforatum, Pine Bark Extract, Mucuna Pruriens, Zinc and Vitamin D2
- **Dosage Form**: Tablet (10 x 10 Tablets)
- **MRP**: ₹1650.00
- **URL**: https://reditionpharma.com/product/qlong-gold-tablets
- **Key Advantage**: Dual nitric oxide precursors with Biopeprine-enhanced bioavailability for microvascular circulation, physical stamina, and adaptogenic vitality.
